messages.subject: table cell color
parts:
hello every one,

in my ui.r i have:

div(dataTableOutput("summaCpCpk"))

in server.r i have:
output$summaCpCpk <- renderDataTable({
    if(! is.null(input$file1)){
      dfCpCpk()$donnees
    }else{
      return() 
    }        
  })
the output is a table with four columns (parameter, length, cp, cpk),
i want to change the background of my two columns cp, cpk corresponding to their values:
EXE: if cp>1.5 ==> background = green  
           if cp<=1.5 ==> background = red
and the same thing for cpk, i want to do that with jquery if i can??

if you have some ideas how we can do that,

thanks for your help

regards

Alex

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: table cell color
parts:
This is a good JQuery exercise, but I do not have time to go into the
details. With the development version of shiny
(https://github.com/rstudio/shiny), you can provide a DataTables call
back function `fnRowCallback`. An example here:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/356 (I do not think it is too
difficult to change background colors after you have learned how to
make the cells bold)

Regards,
Yihui
